content: In his second apology, written in exile, Ṣāʾin al-Dīn is by MK's account particularly scathing about al-Jazarī: he says the man knew only Quran reading and a little hadith and won his position through his native Arabic, and began to make trouble for Ṣāʾin al-Dīn's students because Ṣāʾin al-Dīn had once given a less than glowing report of him when pressed by the Mamluk sultan in Cairo.
